_comment: Tier-2 for sparta conjugate_heat_transfer, ambipolar_plasma and adaptive_grid: three setup-time traps, two loud and one silent. Five decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). conjugate_heat_transfer:5 — the SAME deck was run twice, once with ar.species and ar.vss copied into the working directory and once with nothing copied; staged it exits 0, unstaged it prints 'ERROR on proc 0: Cannot open species file ar.species (../particle.cpp:711)'. Running the pair is what makes that message evidence for the cwd claim rather than evidence that some deck somewhere fails. ambipolar_plasma:4 — the same deck was run with two surf_react prob files differing only in one probability value; 1.5 gives 'ERROR: Surface reaction probability for a species > 1.0 (../surf_react_prob.cpp:287)' with no stats row at all, so the validation is at READ time, and 0.5 runs. adaptive_grid:5 — 'balance_grid rcb cell' and 'balance_grid rcb part' on a serial build both print exactly 'Balance grid migrated 0 cells' and the run continues to completion, so a zero there is not an error report and balance_grid is not a remedy for a load imbalance inside one rank. No measured number is pinned. COVERS: conjugate_heat_transfer:5, ambipolar_plasma:4, adaptive_grid:5.
expect_in_output: species_file_not_staged_message=ERROR on proc 0: Cannot open species file ar.species (../particle.cpp:711)
surf_react_probability_above_one_message=ERROR: Surface reaction probability for a species > 1.0 (../surf_react_prob.cpp:287)
